description: Prod topics (groups) for the 2028/2032/2036 markets. `existing` maps slug → id as read from GET https://api.manifold.markets/search-groups and /v0/group/by-id on 2026-10-06. `missing` lists topics that do not exist yet: Tod creates them (creation fails with a 404 on a missing id), adds the ids under `existing`, and regenerates. The generator attaches at most 5 topics per market (MAX_GROUPS_PER_MARKET) and silently drops missing slugs, listing them in topics-needed.md.
